E1.name: Electronic Expansion Valve Failure
E1.description: The electronic expansion valve (EEV) has failed or is not responding to control signals.

probable_causes.check: Check output from EEV driver on control board
Inspect connections between EEV and control board
Check for moisture or debris in refrigerant system

immediate: Check stepper motor resistance at valve connector
Inspect wiring harness for damage or loose connections

scenarios.driver_board_failed: Replace control board EEV driver circuit
scenarios.contamination: Recover refrigerant, replace drier, evacuate and recharge

E3.name: Discharge Temperature High
E3.description: Compressor discharge temperature has exceeded safe operating limits (typically > 125°C).

probable_causes.check: Verify condenser fan operation and amps

probable_causes.cause: High head pressure due to air

probable_causes.check: Check compressor efficiency and oil condition

immediate: Shut down compressor immediately to prevent damage
Inspect condenser coils and clean if necessary

scenarios.low_charge: Recover refrigerant, find leak, repair, and recharge to spec
scenarios.dirty_coils: Clean condenser coils with chemical cleaner and water rinse
scenarios.fan_failure: Test fan motor, capacitor, and replace if faulty
scenarios.air_in_system: Recover refrigerant, evacuate to 500 microns, recharge

E4.name: Low Oil Pressure
E4.description: Compressor oil pressure has dropped below safe operating threshold.

probable_causes.check: Check oil sight glass or level indicator
Check for refrigerant migration to oil sump

immediate: Shut down compressor immediately to prevent catastrophic failure
Verify oil pressure with mechanical gauge

scenarios.low_oil: Add compressor oil to proper level (check oil type)
scenarios.refrigerant_in_oil: Check crankcase heater operation, repair if needed

E8.name: Supply Air Temperature Sensor Failure
E8.description: The supply air temperature sensor is reading out of range or not communicating.

probable_causes.check: Inspect sensor for corrosion or damage

immediate: Check sensor resistance at room temperature
Test for open or short in wiring

scenarios.wiring_issue: Repair or replace sensor wiring harness
scenarios.connection_issue: Clean and reseat connector, apply dielectric grease

H1.name: High Head Pressure
H1.description: Condenser pressure exceeds safe operating limits.

scenarios.fan_failure: Test and replace fan motor or capacitor
scenarios.overcharge: Recover excess refrigerant to proper charge

L1.name: Low Suction Pressure
L1.description: Suction pressure has dropped below normal operating range.

probable_causes.check: Check for drier or TXV restriction
Check filter, fan belt, and airflow

immediate: Inspect air filter and replace if dirty

scenarios.low_charge: Find leak, repair, evacuate and recharge
scenarios.restriction: Replace liquid line drier or check TXV operation
scenarios.airflow_issue: Replace filter, check fan motor and belt condition

A1.name: Compressor Short Cycle
A1.description: Compressor is cycling on and off rapidly (short cycling).

probable_causes.cause: Dirty air filter causing high head pressure

immediate: Check and replace air filter if dirty

scenarios.dirty_filter: Replace air filter and establish maintenance schedule
scenarios.system_issue: Check charge, airflow, and adjust as needed

E5.name: Low Voltage Protection
E5.description: Supply voltage has dropped below acceptable threshold (< 90% of rated).

probable_causes.check: Measure incoming voltage at main disconnect
Check all power connections for tightness
Verify wire gauge matches unit ampacity

immediate: Measure voltage at unit and main panel

scenarios.utility_issue: Contact utility provider, install voltage monitor
scenarios.connection_issue: Tighten all connections, torque to spec

AL01.name: Alarm - General
AL01.description: General alarm condition - check specific alarm code details.

probable_causes.check: Check controller for specific alarm details

immediate: Check controller alarm history for details

AL03.name: Low Ambient Temperature Lockout
AL03.description: Ambient temperature is below safe operating limits.

immediate: Check if low ambient option is installed
